name: Opportunist / Role Model
life_theme: Build a strong community of influence, then become a role model through embodied living.
work_pattern: Career built entirely through existing network and close relationships. Not designed for cold outreach or mass visibility. Influence grows through trusted circles over time.
career_approach: Invest deeply in your community. Your opportunities will come from people who know and trust you. By mid-career, start developing the qualities of the role model you're designed to become.
growth_edge: Accepting that influence through a small network is valid — you don't need mass reach.
